name: ARIADNE
summary: A nuclear-magnetic-resonance search for axion-mediated short-range spin-dependent forces, generated by a nearby laboratory source mass.
detection_principle: A rotating tungsten sprocket modulates a hypothetical spin interaction, driving polarized helium-3 nuclear-spin resonance; a SQUID reads out the magnetization response.

results.summary: The sources describe R&D and projected sensitivity, rather than a discovered signal in a direct Galactic-dark-matter search.

science_scope: Tests axion-mediated short-range spin-dependent forces with a controllable laboratory source mass. Primarily probes virtual-particle exchange, without requiring axions to constitute Galactic dark matter; it does not directly measure Galactic axion flux or real axion production.
